officialSources.name: Apple Personal Safety User Guide, Manage location metadata in Photos
officialSources.note: Photos Info reveals location when present. Apple documents Adjust Location, No Location, and a separate Share Options Location toggle for that share.

officialSources.name: Google Photos Help, Android photo locations
officialSources.note: Google Photos distinguishes the location recorded by a camera from estimated and user-entered locations. It cannot remove the camera location through this UI. External copies may retain the original. Landmarks can reveal place independently.

example.task: Check whether a crop can retain GPS metadata in the exported JPEG.
inputs: Original 160×120 abstract JPEG with a synthetic GPS tag
steps: Crop and save once with original EXIF passed to the encoder.
Save the same crop with no EXIF passed.
Reopen all three JPEGs and read the EXIF GPS directory.
example.result: The original and metadata-preserving crop contained GPS tags. The copy saved without EXIF had no GPS tag.
example.readerImpact: Check the exact exported file, even if the visible crop looks ready.
example.limits: Local synthetic sample with no user image. It does not establish how mobile apps or SpicyBox process metadata.
example.conditions: Local Windows workstation; original synthetic or numerical sample only; all inputs local.

limits: No SpicyBox account operation, personal photo upload, purchase, generation or export test was performed.
